findings.passage: Common-sense gun reform is not about infringing upon the rights of responsible gun owners; it is about implementing measures that can help prevent tragedies from occurring in the first place. Universal background checks, closing loopholes, and banning military-style assault weapons are just a few of the measures that could make a significant difference.
findings.note: Op-ed under her byline, Garland Journal, 'Reflecting on the Anniversary of Gun Violence'. Names background checks, closing loopholes and an assault-weapon ban as measures.

findings.passage: I want to urge our federal, state and local officials to give the same amount of effort and intensity to creating safer gun laws and expanding access to mental health services. This cannot be our new way of life in Georgia when there is always a solution.
findings.note: Georgia House press release, joint statement after the May 3, 2023 Midtown Atlanta shooting. The same release says she and three colleagues continue to amplify 2023 bills on risk protection orders, lost or stolen gun reporting, secure storage, under-21 sales of semiautomatic assault weapons and rapid-fire devices.

findings.passage: What angers me is that an unnecessary act of violence and unrestricted gun use has cost these public servants their lives. The mental and physical actions of one have devastated an entire community, and we cannot keep failing to protect those who protect us.
